name: vdm-comms
description: Meetings and correspondence discipline: a configurable contract linter for meetings/<date>-<slug>/ and series files, a drift signal for the generated registry and per-track meeting pointers, a draft guard that refuses to mark an unsent letter as sent, and a pending-item detector that reads both date markers (clock and (due:)) and answers who owes what by when. The wording of everything written into the project is configurable (comms.labels), defaulting to English.
